entries.sourceReference: Original adapted crossover movement and physical glove/boot/tool-contact choreography based on Isaac2008 equipment. Plasma Cutter special is emitted from its actual compact cutting head. Not official exported animation, not certified frame-exact canon. Guard is physical bracing, never a RIG energy shield. The generic charge states are adapted readiness/contact, not a canonical charge-up power.

normalization.method: Connected-alpha whole-pose segmentation; one body calibration, nearest-neighbor pixel scale and render factor per native source. Explicit real corrective rows inserted without synthesizing anatomy.
normalization.baselineDefinition: bottom-exclusive full-pose alpha bound; ledge attachment uses separately measured real native palms.
normalization.alphaCleanup: Exclude near-transparent background noise below24; original PNGs archived unchanged.

visualValidation.facing: Right by default apart from genuine KO/airborne anatomical projection.
visualValidation.outfit: Original2008 bronze/brown ribbed level3 engineering RIG, enclosed helmet with3horizontalcyanvisorbars, heavy gloves/boots, cyan spine on the back only. Adult engineer proportions.
visualValidation.weapons: Compact industrial Plasma Cutter with physical short cutting head/prongs, no conventional rifle; motion/ledge keeps it secured at hip. Physical contact rows do not emit plasma; special frame2 has compact muzzle flash from actual tool tip; guard is physical.
visualValidation.stature: 190px effective body calibration per native source; crouches, hanging arms and lowered projections keep their native proportions. Corrective source uses its own documented upright calibration.
limitations: Generated adapted crossover choreography, not official extracted frames or verified source1:1.
Runtime facing mirrors native artwork, including suit/equipment asymmetry.
Source-wide calibration preserves real crouch/air/hang shortening; no per-pose body warp.
Generic melee charge actions are adapted physical readiness/contact states, not a canonical chargeable plasma power.
Leading glove contact points are actual visible anatomy; labeling does not certify hidden anatomical handedness.
